   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  JULY 8, 2024

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:04 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang,
Commissioner Beacham and Commissioner Sanchez. Also present was Levy Sun, Director of
Communications and Public Affairs, Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III and Public Safety
Commissioners Michael Rosoff and Kim Apodaca.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Leon made the motion and Commissioner Sanchez seconded to approve the minutes
for June 10, 2024. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

First Responder’s Appreciation Luncheon

Mrs. Ocegueda reminded the Commissioners that the event will be held at the Norwalk Art & Sports
Complex in the Sproul Room this year. Mrs. Ocegueda also informed Commissioners that the Hargitt
Room and Courtyard are reserved to use for meal serving and sitting overflow. The event runs from
11:30am to 1:30pm, and Commissioners need to be there by 10am to assist in the set-up.
Commissioners decided on an annual design that would be a red, white and blue star theme with gold
or silver highlights. Commissioners also agreed to continue pre-distributing the meal tickets to
attendees. Mrs. Ocegueda asked for recommendations where she can obtain food quotes. SoCal
Pizza, Lee’s Sandwiches, and Wok Deli were all recommended. Commissioner Rosoff asked about
raffle ticket distribution. Mr. Sun made the Commission aware of comments made by attendees last
year that Norwalk’s Public Safety Department won a lot of the prizes. Commissioners decided on
having two different types/color tickets.

Business Spotlight

Mr. Sun showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the June Sushi Spots edition video to
Commissioners. Mr. Sun provided Commissioners with a copy of the finalized Business Spotlight
Guidelines. Commissioner Beacham praised staff for their work on this campaign. Mrs. Ocegueda
stated that she will be reaching out to Caren of the Chamber of Commerce to help promote the monthly
theme to get businesses to engage more if they fall into that month’s category.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Mr. Sun provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s overall
reach across all outreach platforms for the last month. Mr. Sun shared the availability of FlashVote that
can be used to survey the community.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
July 8, 2024

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda asked for clarification on the Commission’s responsibility and schedule of assisting the
Arturo Sanchez Sr. Halloween Parade. Commissioner Ang suggested having the assisting
Commissioners be at the announcement stand by 9am. Commissioner Sanchez stated that the parade
start time is 11am and depending on number of entries, the end time can vary, although a two-hour
timeframe was suggested. Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners to decide on a table format for next
year’s Meet & Greet event as she needs to submit the paperwork to reserve the room. Mrs. Ocegueda
reminded the Commission that the event will occur on Friday, June 13, 2025, and will be moved from
the Sproul Barn to the Sproul Room. Commissioners confirmed that would like to keep the round table
format but would like to eliminate the chairs with the back facing the stage to eliminate viewing hardship
of department presentations. Commissioners discussed possibly using Friday the 13th movie as the
theme. Commissioner Beacham asked staff to begin researching branded items to give away. Mr.
Sun informed the Commission they have an $800 budget for appreciation items.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Beacham mentioned her attendance for the First Responder Luncheon is tentative.
Commissioners asked staff to reach out to the Art in Public Places Commission Liaison to research the
process for a collaboration for a logo art contest. Commissioners agreed to roll over the past décor
contest winners’ gift cards to the First Responders Luncheon raffle.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:35 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
